rule: A group is priced by the unified engine if in scope, UNLESS the walk-forward replay shows harm: >= 3 replayed contracts and unified Brier worse than production by > 0.05. Groups with < 3 replayed contracts are published (no evidence of harm). Lebanon / Saudi->Yemen dailies stay on the during-war model (pilot/fighting_state.py). Exclusions are computed, never hand-picked.
